theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid d)) (g : Euclid d → Euclid P) (π : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid d) (c : Euclid P), IsOpen D → DifferentiableOn ℝ g D → (∀ a ∈ D, π (g a - c) = a) → InjOn g D ∧ ∀ a ∈ D, π ∘L fderiv ℝ g a = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid d) ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ g a)
